lines.en: You've received a new message from Niki Nakayama!
: Hah...
: Look at you, acting all exhausted even though nothing’s happened yet.
: It’s because I know things are going to happen that I’m exhausted.
: Any minute now, I’m going to be indefinitely supervised by two girls who could probably beat me up if they wanted to and there’s nothing I can do but go along with it.
: I mean, you could always align yourself with one of the two floors and just push through your defenders and take the hug into your own hands. Or arms. Or both since it’s a hug.
: What I’m saying is you can go hug somebody.
: Oh is that what you meant? I didn’t quite catch that.
: You sleep on the wrong side of Ami’s bed or something? You seem kinda grumpy today.
: I am an adult with my own adult bed, thank you very much. And I can be sarcastic if I want to be.
: It’s not the sarcasm I have an issue with, Senpai. It’s how you’re over here looking like you’re dead set on not enjoying yourself for the rest of the weekend. Why?
: You’re basically a celebrity during the Dorm Wars. Everybody’s fighting for your attention. So why would anyone want to fight for some guy who just...mopes around all the time?
: Hey, look. You’re finally starting to get it.
: Wait, so you don’t want to be the center of attention anymore? I’m confused.
: I don’t know what I want. I’m confused too.
: It just feels like things are going to get even more difficult no matter what happens and I thought I’d have a little more time to kind of...blend into the background before coming back here.
: You’ve had more than half a year, haven’t you? We haven’t been here since Christmas.
: And to me, it feels like Christmas was only a short while ago.
: Well, I can’t tell what’s going on in that big, pointy head of yours...like, ever. But I’m sure that whatever it is will turn out just fine in the long run.
: For now, just focus on relaxing until the time comes for the two of us to stare at a couple girls modeling swimsuits and striking suggestive poses. That should cheer you up, right?
: I’d cheer up even quicker if I could see you striking suggestive poses in a swimsuit. Why are you still wearing your normal clothes? You should relax too.
: Can I not relax in normal clothes? That’s what you’re doing. Or...should be doing.
: You can, just-
: Don’t worry about me. Just figure out a way to exist without dragging down everybody else on the beach. This trip is for them at the end of the day.
: All we’re doing is chaperoning and giving them something to fantasize about when they crawl into their futons later tonight.
: What will you fantasize about when you crawl into yours?
: Nothing. Because I’m sleeping in the bed with Wakana and you’re going to be the one stuck on the floor fantasizing about us.
: Or probably just Wakana because she’s the forbidden fruit. But I’ll also be there, so...
: You know what? I’m just gonna go call her. But you should start watching your back, Senpai. Think it’s only a matter of time until there’s a target painted on it.
: I often think I was just born with one of those on me, so I’m not sure if there is anything I can do at this point to protect myself.
: Then rely on your bodyguards or whatever. Imani out.
Imani wanders off to call Wakana and-
And I get a call of my own.
: Hello?
: Hey. Are you free right now?
: Are you free right now? Because I figured you’d be doing “famous idol” stuff.
: I don’t like the sarcasm placed on “famous idol” there. Just because you don’t give a shit doesn’t mean millions of other people don’t.
: My bad. I woke up on the wrong side of Ami’s bed today.
: Why were you sleeping in Ami’s bed? Where did she sleep?
: Outside. What’s going on? Why are you calling?
: Uhhhh...obviously because I want to see you.
: Say it again, but in a more tsundere way this time.
: It’s not like I actually wanted to see you or anything, idiot. I just dialed your number on accident.
: That’s more like it. And thank you for going along with that so easily. I needed it.
: Something wrong?
: I don’t know. Maybe.
: Something I can help with?
: Sure. If you want to come over to the beach and have sex with me all night.
: Sure.
: Really? Because I was being sarcastic again there.
: Do you want to fuck me or not? Because I have to figure out which outfit to wear and your answer to that will help me choose.
: I do...I just don’t know how possible it will be when there are going to be over twenty other girls here who might-
: I’m famous. I’ll figure it out. Now go jerk off or something so you’ll last longer.
: Sure, yeah. Let me just go jerk off behind a tree. That’s a safe thing to do on a public beach.
: Wow, you really are sassy today, huh? Whatever. Save that attitude for the bedroom. Bye.
: Oh, love you. I think we’re supposed to say that now.
: Are we?
: Yeah. So say it back, asshole.
: I...love you too.
: Say it again, but in a more tsundere way this time.
: It’s not like I actually love you or anything. I’m just saying it because you’re making me.
: Amazing. I’m wet already.
: Same.
: Aaaand now I’m hanging up.
Niki ends the call and...I suddenly have something to look forward to tonight.
Something it’s okay to look forward to.
Something I can’t be condemned or ridiculed for because it’s a thing I love to do with a person I’m meant to be with.
But what if there is more than one person I am meant to be with?
How can I be with all of them?
But more importantly...how can I be myself when there are pieces of me scattered all along the shoreline?
I don’t know.
So I’ll ignore it again.
Until this cross becomes too heavy.
Until my back is broken.
: Look at me. My name’s Maya. I’m all stoic and cool. I love watermelons and have a really nice ass. Anyone want to go read Goodnight Punpun under a bridge?
: What the fuck are you doing?
: Mocking you. That’s what mortal enemies do, right?
: I meant why do you think it’s suddenly acceptable to sit next to me when I want to wear your skin as a suit?
: Because we’re going to be competing all weekend long and I wanted to say good luck before I absolutely decimate you.
: As if I have any interest in this stupid competition. Get lost.
: I mean...the fact that you still abhor me is kind of indicative of you having some semblance of interest in this competition, right?
: Unless you prefer all of your “hugs” with Sensei to remain totally private so nobody knows you’re just as thirsty for him as the rest of us.
: I will rip your fucking tongue out, you brightly-colored waste of carbon.
: Aaaahhhh...
: Wh...What the fuck do you think you’re doing?!
: Helping. You wanna rip it out, right? Go ahead.
: It’d probably be easiest if you used your teeth. Doing it with your fingers might get a little slippery.
: Get...the fuck...away from me.
: Buhhyouhavnbaoffmahhtonnyeh. Aaaahhh.
: Just fucking die already!
: So...it appears we meet again.
: And this time I won’t be distracted by some bitch’s face as I beat her within inches of her life.

: That sounds unfortunate for you as the only time you could ever hurt anyone is while I am not paying attention to you. And I will have my eyes on you until my floor obtains our much deserved points.
: You want those lousy ass points that badly? What’s a girl like you doing chasing after some perverted teacher, anyway? Shouldn’t you be off running your daddy’s noodle shop or some shit?
: Tojo Ramen is closed for the weekend as this matter was more important.
: And while I am not personally chasing after our strange teacher, it does not change the fact that my friends are and I wish to help them.
: Same here. But the difference between you and me is that your friends are all weird as fuck and my friend is just too fuckin’ lovedrunk to see how stupid she is.
: Then the difference between you and me is that you fight on behalf of one person while I carry the hopes and dreams of nine. You are not my equal. You will be destroyed.
: You talk pretty big for somebody who only got the upper hand once just because I was distracted.
: Remaining focused on the battlefield is the key to victory. Failure to do so could result in death if one is not careful.
: You sayin’ you’re gonna kill me? Over a stupid-ass contest?
: There is nothing stupid about following one’s dreams.
: Even if that dream is some pervert’s tiny dick?
: Some prefer salt broth. Some prefer soy.
: Heh?
: It is important to not ridicule someone’s tastes just because they’re different from your own.
: That is one of many lessons I will teach over the next forty-eight hours.
: You ain’t teaching me shit, you noodley bitch.
: It’s difficult to teach those who are unwilling to learn. And in situations like this, it’s not uncommon to rely on force instead.
: Just try it and see how that goes for you, punk.
: Hey. How was your phone call? Is Wakana still mad at me?

: She was more mad that she has to come all the way here just to deliver the results of her contest. But apparently like 80%% of the entrants were from our class, so the timing just kind of worked out in our favor.
: That said, the fuck is going on here? Yumi and Tsuneyo look like they’re going to kill each other. And Maya and Noriko...also look like they’re going to kill each other.
: I guess that one's not really new, though.
: Either way, I disappear for five seconds and everything turns to shit. How the hell did you ever manage without me?
: No clue, but I’m pretty sure this is just how it’s going to be all weekend long thanks to Makoto’s brilliant contest idea.
: Well, great. I guess here’s hoping you’re actually conscious enough to help me pull the girls apart this time since Tsuneyo clearly won’t be able to.
: I doubt it will come to that. But, then again, if they’re already this combative before the contest has even started, it’s hard to say how things will be once it has.
: When does this contest start anyway? I don’t remember hearing a time.
: I don’t think there was one. I think it’s just whenever Uta and Makoto see fit.
: Gotcha.
: That’s about to happen, isn't it?
: I’m glad I wasn’t the only one who was feeling it.
: Attention, everyone!
: Seeing as tensions are just about to boil over, me and Makoto-
: Makoto and I.
: Makoto and Makoto have decided to announce the start of her weird hug fight! All combatants, go! Go! Gooooooo!
: Feel the power of friendship!
: Wha- I wasn’t ready, you fucking bitch!
: As mentioned...being prepared on the battlefield is of utmost importance! You...have dug your own grave!
: The...fuck! Let go of my leg! Fight me standing up and...save both of us some...fucking dignity!
: Yumi! Tsuneyo! You’re meant to be guarding Sensei! Not fighting each other!
: See, this is exactly why your contest was a bad idea, Makocchi. Nobody gets the rules and now we’re gonna lose one of our classmates.
: Forget our classmates, the Tsukioka Foundation is almost sure to pull their funding if someone dies on our watch.
: Crap! Tsuneyo! Just knock her out! Don’t go for the kill!
: Yumi! Regain control! You need to get on top!
: Easier...said than done!
: Noriko! Seize the opportunity and charge the target!
: On it!
: Wait one fucking second, you’re seriously-
: Wha-
: I will fucking murder you!
: Early bird gets the worm, bitch!
: Ami! Help!
: As if you even had to ask...
: Tch. I should have known this was coming.

: Hey, Ami. Don’t you think you might be a little too attached to Sensei? Like, in a way that’s definitely really weird. And how you should probably stop because you’re suffocating him and incest is illegal.
: No. I don’t think any of that. And right now, all that matters is protecting him from your evil clutches.
: Evil? You’ve known me since I was little. You know I’m not evil.
: You’re the only one with memories going back that far. And I’m sorry to break the news like this, but all of my memory space is reserved for Sensei. There’s no room for you in there.
: If you want to get to Sensei, you’ll have to go through me.
: Ami, I’m bigger and stronger than you. And also an expert when it comes to tickling. You stand no chance. Now, step aside.
: Tickle me if you must! I will never stop protecting Sensei! No matter how many of you must tickle me!
: Shh, you’re going to give people ideas and it’s going to turn into a whole thing. Just move out of the way. The sleepover is at your house. You’re going to be there either way.
: And let you wrap your filthy arms around my uncle?! Never!
: Good, Ami! Now I-
: You stay put too! Nobody hugs Sensei but me and I’ll win this contest on my own!
: We’ll see about that!
As expected, the beach quickly erupts into chaos and all of the girls who haven’t already wandered off or gone back to the inn are left scrambling through the sand.
All but a few of them, of course.
My so-called bodyguards are too busy trying to kill each other to properly guard me. And with Ami chasing off Noriko and Maya as disinterested in making a move as ever, I think I’m safe for now.
Or at least as safe as I possibly can be in an environment where, as Imani said, there is a target painted on my back.
Perhaps it would be easiest to just lie down and let whichever arrow is flying the fastest pierce my heart.
The issue with that is that there would be no one there to remove those arrows, and that I’d be covered from head to toe in open wounds before I even know it.
What matters in times like these is remembering who you are and where you come from.
What matters is casting aside all expectations of forward momentum and surrounding yourself with familiar skin that will fuse to the ground and keep you right where you are.
Some people call that cowardice.
But me?
I call it risk management.
And there’s a certain level of comfort to be found in remembering you’ll never trip if you don’t try to walk.
: So, Sensei! Any plans for the rest of the morning? Or are you gonna stick around and watch what’ll probably just become a permanent boxing match?
: I think the plan is to just stay here until someone decides for me what I’ll be doing instead.
: Then-
: Then, would you like to maybe accompany me for a little while?
: Whaaaat? No fair! I was about to ask the same thing.
: Well, you should have moved faster.
: Is that okay, Sensei? It won’t be long. I just have a few more papers for you to sign, if that’s okay. And I need your final approval for this year's Dorm Wars official itinerary.
: Well, it appears my decision has been made for me. I hereby formally apologize to everyone who didn’t ask as quickly as Makoto.
: God frickin’ damn it. How come she’s so good at stealin’ Sensei away from the rest of us? Like, don’t ya see enough of that guy in school? Cut us some slack. Right, girls?
: Girls?
: Oh. Y...Yeah. Cut us some slack.
: Now, then. Shall we get going?
: Fine. But I’m actually reading whatever papers you’re making me go over this time so you can’t pull one over on me again.
: Oh, please. As if I’d ever trick you like that.
With Makoto’s help, I manage to escape the chaos and come a little bit closer to a breath of fresh air.
